title: How can I select multiple Library stickers
question: How can I select multiple Library stickers?
answer: Tick the square selection markers or drag a box over the stickers. Shift adds to the selection and Ctrl un-selects, so you can delete selected stickers together. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
